data_engineering.question: How should data be generated, ingested, stored, transformed, orchestrated, served, governed, or observed?

forecasting.question: How should baselines, transformations, diagnostics, forecast models, uncertainty, or forecast evaluation be designed?

financial_ml_research.question: How should an end-to-end financial ML research workflow be designed and evaluated?

feature_engineering.question: How should market, calendar, physical, or model-derived features be constructed without leakage?

model_selection_and_tuning.question: How should candidate models, hyperparameters, calibration, and selection budgets be controlled?

temporal_integrity_and_leakage.question: How should event time, availability time, versions, training-serving boundaries, and leakage controls be enforced?

temporal_integrity.purpose: Make every model input reconstructable at the decision timestamp.

rules.instruction: Record event time, availability time, source, version/as-of identity, and revision state for every forecast input whose publication can lag observation.
At each decision timestamp, join only records whose declared availability time is not later than that timestamp; fail closed when timing cannot be defended.
Fit scaling, imputation, encoding, feature selection, calibration, and learned transformations inside the active training fold only, then apply them forward.
Keep reserved-confirmation outcomes unread and unusable during design, fitting, tuning, calibration, model selection, threshold selection, and feature revision.

target_definition.purpose: Bind the forecast target to the intended trading decision and executable exposure.

rules.instruction: Declare decision timestamp, target start/end, forecast horizon, target units, and contract/roll identity before model fitting.
Construct labels so no value published or realized after the decision timestamp enters a predictor or selection statistic.
Identify overlapping target windows and require purge, embargo, or dependence-aware evaluation whenever overlap can leak label information across folds.
Keep the statistical forecast target separate from signal policy and executable P&L accounting; document the translation explicitly.

feature_engineering.purpose: Create features whose timing, transformation, and missingness are reproducible out of sample.

rules.instruction: For every feature family, record raw source, timing semantics, transformation, lag, revision behavior, and the decision-time availability rule.
Estimate data-dependent transformations and feature-selection decisions only on the training sample of the active fold.
Represent unavailable, not-yet-published, structurally absent, and genuinely missing values explicitly instead of silently forward filling across an information boundary.
Require simple feature-family baselines and controlled ablations before crediting a large feature set with incremental forecast value.

validation_and_cross_validation.purpose: Estimate generalization using chronological, dependence-aware partitions.

rules.instruction: Use chronological train/validation/test ordering; do not use random K-fold validation for temporally dependent forecast samples.
When comparing or tuning candidates, keep model selection inside inner walk-forward folds and reserve outer folds for unbiased selection-performance estimation.
Purge or embargo observations whose label windows or information sets overlap across fold boundaries, with the gap derived from the target construction.
Preserve all attempted candidates and fold-level scores, including failures, so the selection path and research multiplicity remain auditable.

model_selection_and_tuning.purpose: Bound candidate search so selection evidence remains interpretable and reproducible.

rules.instruction: Before selection, declare the candidate families, hyperparameter ranges, objective, calibration choices, and compute/search budget.
Include naive, seasonal, linear, and other decision-relevant simple baselines appropriate to the target before promoting more complex candidates.
Choose hyperparameters, model family, calibration, thresholds, and feature subsets using training/inner-validation evidence only.
Fit calibrators and stackers from out-of-fold base-model predictions and treat their fitting as a separate selection boundary with its own timing controls.

forecast_evaluation.purpose: Judge forecasts against target-matched baselines with uncertainty and diagnostic context.

rules.instruction: Score against target-matched naive, seasonal, simple statistical, and market-implied baselines where each comparator is defensible and available at forecast time.
Choose primary and secondary metrics from the target units and downstream decision; do not substitute an easier metric after outcomes are observed.
Report residual/error diagnostics by horizon and predeclared market state, including bias, scale, autocorrelation/dependence, and failure concentration.
When probabilistic forecasts are used, evaluate interval or quantile calibration and sharpness, and use dependence-aware uncertainty for comparative claims.

backtesting.purpose: Translate forecast information into auditable, executable trading outcomes without timing or accounting shortcuts.

rules.instruction: Record signal timestamp, earliest executable fill timestamp, execution rule, and actual held contract; reject same-bar fills unless market timing makes them defensible.
Apply declared spread, slippage, fees, contract sizing/rounding, margin/capital constraints, and roll costs before evaluating trading value.
Carry positions across bars explicitly, account for entries, exits, rolls, and flat states, and derive P&L from the instrument actually held rather than a proxy target series.
Preserve signal, order/fill assumption, position, contract, cost, and equity ledgers while keeping reserved-confirmation outcomes outside policy optimization.

methodology_map.current_rule: Forecast inputs must be reconstructable from information available at the decision time.
Reserved-confirmation outcomes remain unused before the governed confirmation boundary.
Retain bounded change history, failures, evidence lineage, and reproducible environment identity.
Research requires declared comparators and decision-relevant benchmarks.
methodology_map.missing_control: Formalize a reusable baseline ladder per target/horizon and require forecast residual diagnostics.

methodology_map.current_rule: Chronological OOS and confirmation boundaries exist, but nested model-selection topology is not yet a repository-wide executable contract.
methodology_map.missing_control: Implement nested walk-forward outer evaluation with inner-only tuning, purge/embargo rules, and retained fold evidence.

methodology_map.current_rule: Trading and simulation policies define costs and execution constraints, but Programme 003 needs one complete signal-to-fill-to-held-contract ledger contract.
methodology_map.missing_control: Complete and verify signal timestamp, fill timestamp, held contract, position persistence, roll, cost, and P&L accounting as one baseline path.

methodology_map.current_rule: Evaluation statistics exist, but calibrated interval/quantile coverage is not a universal forecast contract.
methodology_map.missing_control: Require calibration and coverage checks whenever a candidate emits probabilistic forecasts.

methodology_map.current_rule: PIT and environment controls exist, but training-versus-serving feature equivalence is not yet a production contract.
methodology_map.missing_control: Add feature freshness, schema parity, training-serving skew, and inference-input audit checks before production hardening.

methodology_map.current_rule: Source provenance and verification are strong, but operational data-quality objectives and pipeline observability are not yet formalized.
methodology_map.missing_control: Define production freshness, completeness, lineage, failure, and recovery telemetry only when Phase 8 is justified.

methodology_map.current_rule: Research revisit triggers exist; production drift and retraining controls do not.
methodology_map.missing_control: Define drift detection, retraining authority, rollback, and model suspension rules after prospective edge exists.

missing_controls.requirement: Define target/horizon-specific naive, seasonal, statistical, and market-implied baselines plus residual diagnostics.
Implement outer chronological evaluation with inner-only tuning and target-derived purge/embargo.
Complete signal-to-fill-to-held-contract-to-cost-to-P&L accounting in one auditable path.
Evaluate interval/quantile calibration and coverage for probabilistic specialist forecasts.
Add feature freshness, schema parity, skew, drift, retraining, rollback, and model suspension controls.
Define freshness, completeness, lineage, failure, recovery, and serving observability after prospective edge is demonstrated.
